measurement_definitions.prefill_tps_client: Uncached input tokens / (last request first-token time - earliest request start). Includes queueing, first output chunk and interleaved decode.
measurement_definitions.decode_tps_client: (Output tokens - all tokens in first chunk) / (last chunk time - first chunk time). Cold concurrent requests may include later requests' prefills in this interval.
measurement_definitions.end_to_end_output_tps_client: Total output tokens / (latest request last-chunk time - earliest request start). Includes prefill, queueing and TTFT.
measurement_definitions.per_user_end_to_end_output_tps: Each request output tokens / its elapsed time; report median over users.
measurement_definitions.steady_decode: Count delivered tokens in common interval from latest first chunk to earliest last chunk; all users are decoding. A short overlap window can increase sampling noise.
measurement_definitions.warm_cache: Replay cold prompt with one appended token. Report TTFT/hits; do not treat cached logical tokens as computed prefill work.
measurement_definitions.limitations: Fixed 128-token outputs and synthetic long cache-policy prompts are not a full code-agent workload or quality evaluation.

prefix_switch_comparison.protocol: Same exact 8192-token inputs and 128-token greedy outputs, concurrency 1/8, two repetitions each. Both servers warmed before measurement; unique cold prefixes, reset enabled cache before each batch. No hit-rate or capacity tuning.
prefix_switch_comparison.fixed_config: Q8 KV, draft3, 12 GiB KV pool, 262144 max model length, 8192 batch tokens, 2048 block size, 8 max sequences.
prefix_switch_comparison.scope: Measures the complete supported prefix-cache configuration, including GDN state checkpoints in align mode.
